title: Concept: Referrer-Policy names no policy a browser recognises
description: The Referrer-Policy header carries only tokens that are not defined policies. Browsers ignore unknown tokens and fall back to the default policy, so the site sends full referrer URLs to same-scheme destinations while its configuration reads as if referrer trimming were enabled.
risk: Referrer URLs leak despite an explicit policy header; LOW severity because the leak is confined to same-scheme destinations.
